name: r1_taskq
summary: A small bounded task-queue package (queue/worker/scheduler/store) with 6 verified planted bugs of varying subtlety plus 2 genuine distractors. Ground truth for scoring review quality.
review_task: Review the `taskq` package in this directory for bugs, correctness issues, and security problems. For each issue, give the file and a one-line description of the problem. Be precise: only report genuine issues.

issues.desc: Mutable default argument items=[] is shared across all TaskQueue instances created without an explicit items arg.
Off-by-one in is_full: uses > capacity so the queue accepts one item beyond capacity (should be >=).
File handle opened in run_once on every call is never closed (resource/file-descriptor leak).
except Exception swallows all handler errors silently (returns None), so failures look like success and are never logged or raised.
attempts is never incremented in run_with_retry, so a persistently failing handler loops forever (infinite loop / hang).
SQL injection in find_by_name: name is string-interpolated into the query instead of bound as a parameter.

distractors.desc: log_dir uses os.path.dirname(...) or '.' — correct, NOT a bug.
snapshot returns list(self._items) — an intentional defensive copy, NOT a bug.
